W5.content: Give the OpenAI-compatible catalog fetch a per-profile models path, so a provider whose catalog route differs from its chat route can be described instead of broken. The routes are genuinely inverted and this was re-derived here with an API key attached, since an unauthenticated 404 can be an auth artifact rather than a routing fact: GET /models 404 both without a key and with a bearer, GET /v1/models 401 invalid_api_key (so the route exists and only the key is wrong), POST /chat/completions 401, POST /v1/chat/completions 404. So appending /v1 to api_base fixes the catalog and breaks chat, and the fix must be a per-provider catalog-path override rather than an api_base edit. There is no Default impl and no macro for OpenAiCompatibleProfile, so an added field touches all 36 literals; all 36 are in catalog.rs and none elsewhere. Three call sites build {api_base}/models independently: openrouter-runtime lib.rs:543 inside fetch_models_from_api, provider-doctor live_provider_probes.rs:98, and base usage/api_keys.rs:57. Only the doctor site has the profile in scope today; the runtime site is handed a bare api_base String, so the override must reach it without widening that signature carelessly.
